description: Synthetic sesslint.repair.registry parity (Recipe construction, register_recipe, lookup, recipes_for, list_recipes, clear_registry).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-registry-live-map: Python __all__ exports REGISTRY as a live dict alias of the in-process table. Rust exposes ALL and lookup via get_recipe and list_recipes instead of handing out the map.

GAP-registry-non-string-name: Python Recipe.__post_init__ raises ValueError when name is not a str. Rust Recipe::try_new takes &str and documents NON_STRING_NAME_UNREPRESENTABLE — parity not required on that branch.
